items.title: Al Rose Interview, 1975-02-19
items.q: as far as Leonard Feather is concerned, this man is completely venal and will say or write anything that's going to make him any money.

ctx.x: Well, why are musicians satisfied to use the word jazz as well as critics like, say, Leonard Feather or someone like that?

Well, of course, as far as Leonard Feather is concerned, this man is completely venal and will say or write anything that's going to make him any money. And he has no artistic or personal integrity whatever. And I would welcome nothing more than a libel suit against me for making the statements. And it would be a great pleasure to get him into court and demonstrate all this. So that's not... You can't even consider reasonably Leonard Feather as a person. Musicians, of course, are not interested in theory.…
Yeah, and they're also too busy playing to really think much about it, aren't they? They are.
